title: Gate One plugin manifest
description: Signed manifest for an out-of-process Gate One plugin. The Ed25519 signature covers the canonical JSON with signature zeroed, plus the artefact digest. The manifest is provisioned by the operator; the trust store is never fetched from the plugin.

kind.description: Plugin kind. auth requires the trust store to allow auth modules; extensions cover routes, injection, events and transforms.

name.description: Reverse-DNS plugin name. Must match a trust store allowedNames entry (exact or glob).

apiVersion.description: Plugin API version implemented by the artefact (currently v1).

hostAPI.description: Host API constraint, for example >=1.0 <2.0 or *. Compared with the trust store coreVersion.

keyId.description: Signing key id; must exist in the trust store keys map.

dependencies.description: Other artefacts this plugin depends on. Each digest must be allow-listed in the trust store.

capabilities.description: Declared capabilities. An extension cannot declare auth; events requires the events capability.

licenseFeature.description: Optional commercial licence feature required to load this plugin. The host refuses the plugin when the feature is absent.

type.description: Artefact type: binary, container or OCI reference.

digest.description: sha256 digest of the artefact. Verified before the plugin is trusted.

size.description: Optional artefact size in bytes. Verified when non-zero.

platform.description: Optional platform selector, for example linux/amd64.

artifact.description: The signed artefact (binary, container or OCI reference). Its digest is verified before the plugin is trusted.

digest.description: Dependency artefact digest; must match the trust store allowedDependencies entry.

events.description: Usage-event subscription. Only these types are produced for this plugin.

types.description: Subscribed event types; each must also be configured in usage.types.

maxLagBytes.description: Maximum lag before backpressure applies. Default: the type share.

onMaxLag.description: Backpressure policy. block answers affected routes with 503 until the plugin catches up; drop advances the cursor to the lag limit and marks the plugin degraded.

filters.description: Narrow the subscription. Empty fields mean all.

sampleRate.description: Sampling rate for matching events. Default 1.0.

value.description: base64url (unpadded) Ed25519 signature over the canonical manifest plus the artefact digest.

signature.description: Ed25519 signature over the canonical manifest with signature zeroed, plus the artefact digest.
